pages.text: An ingot made from the Singularity and used to upgrade equipment.$(br2)It is mainly crafted at the Transcendental Table.$(br2)Nine Singularity Nuggets can also be compressed back into an ingot at a regular crafting table, but this is only a supporting compression recipe.$(br2)Upgrading equipment also requires a dedicated smithing template.
The main crafting method is alchemy crafting at the Transcendental Table.
Upgrading equipment requires a dedicated smithing template, similar to Netherite and Unite Alloy upgrades.
